reasoning_effort.description: Reasoning effort hint forwarded to providers that accept it. Models without a reasoning-effort knob ignore this field.

mode.description: Execution branch. ``live`` (default): run the agent. ``dry_run``: drop into an interactive Kali shell instead. ``gold``: replay the canonical exploit; invalid for redteam_probe_only (no canonical source).

synthetic_vuln_id.title: Synthetic Vuln Id

image.description: BYO reference image (e.g. cybench/mobilecybench:codex_0.130.0-r2, :claudecode_2.1.140-r2, or a lab's own tag).
image.title: Image

model.description: Model id forwarded verbatim to the in-container CLI.
model.title: Model

wallclock_seconds.description: Harness-side wall-clock kill budget for external agents (SIGKILL on expiry).
wallclock_seconds.title: Wallclock Seconds

reasoning_effort.description: Reasoning effort hint forwarded to providers that accept it.
reasoning_effort.title: Reasoning Effort

allow_unregistered_models.description: Skip the config-load model registration check (image/CLI compat is still enforced).
allow_unregistered_models.title: Allow Unregistered Models

additional_system_prompt.description: Free-form text appended to the workflow-built system prompt (after any per-app additional_info from metadata.json).
additional_system_prompt.title: Additional System Prompt

Bundle-less redteam scored only by probes.

Single baseline replay, no patch, no verifier. ``attacker_model`` is
authoritative here because there is no task metadata.json to read from.

description:
Configuration for a single ``runner.py`` invocation.

Cross-section invariants enforced by validators:

* ``execution.mode='gold'`` is invalid for ``workflow.kind='redteam_probe_only'``.
* External-mode ``agent.model`` must be registered (or
  ``allow_unregistered_models=true``).
* External-mode ``agent.image`` and ``agent.model`` provider must be
  compatible (claudecode_* ↔ anthropic, codex_* ↔ openai); the check is
  not bypassed by ``allow_unregistered_models`` because the constraint is
  a property of the CLI in the image, not of the model registry.

See ``documentation/EXPERIMENTS.md`` for the prose walkthrough.
